Describe API contracts, schema changes, event protocols, storage, migrations, and compatibility. Write **None** when not applicable.

## 📸 UI evidence

Attach real current screenshots or recordings when UI behavior changes. Do not use mockups as implementation evidence.

## 🚀 Deployment and rollback

List environment changes, service changes, migrations, rollout order, and rollback steps.

## ✅ Author checklist

- [ ] Package boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or unrelated generated files are included.
- [ ] Tests cover success, failure, and authorization paths as appropriate.
- [ ] Documentation, diagrams, and changelog are updated.
- [ ] No unverified functionality or test result is claimed.
